label: AI data, content and workflow

related.title: AI Data Evaluator
related.reason: Assesses outputs against rubrics, but may not cover AI content production or workflow implementation.

related.title: AI Content Specialist
related.reason: Develops and reviews model-assisted content, but may not cover dataset evaluation or automation systems.

related.title: AI Automation Specialist
related.reason: Builds AI-enabled workflows, but may not cover labeling, evaluation rubrics, or editorial judgment.

transferable.skill: Uses checklists, records edge cases, and escalates inconsistencies—useful for evaluating labeled data or AI outputs.
Applies style rules, fact-checks drafts, and resolves ambiguity—useful for controlled AI content creation and review.
Maps processes, documents exceptions, and tests repeatable steps—useful for monitored AI-assisted workflows.

caution: Separate data evaluation, AI content, and AI automation; check technical depth, portfolio evidence, seniority, and domain requirements.

label: Podcast and audio production

related.title: Audio Editor
related.reason: Focuses on cleanup, mixing, and mastering; broader producing or editorial responsibilities may differ.

related.title: Podcast Producer
related.reason: Coordinates guests, recording, editorial decisions, and release schedules; hands-on editing depth may differ.

related.title: Radio Producer
related.reason: Plans segments, scripts, and live or recorded output; podcast tools and formats may differ.

transferable.skill: Noise reduction, cuts, levels, and export discipline can support podcast or radio production, depending on tool proficiency.
Deadline control, version tracking, and publishing checks can support reliable episode delivery.
Run-of-show planning, cue awareness, and clear handoffs can support recording and release workflows.

caution: Check reel quality, editing and mixing software, recording experience, seniority, and any format-specific requirements.
